controls.title: Buttons have accessible names
controls.rationale: Every interactive control needs an accessible name.
controls.remediation: Give each button visible text or an accessible name.

verification.description: Run axe against each rendered interaction state.
Confirm the control name with a screen reader.

controls.title: Images have text alternatives
controls.rationale: Non-text content needs a text alternative.
controls.remediation: Add alt text, or alt="" for decorative images.

verification.description: Run axe against each rendered interaction state.

controls.title: Text meets contrast minimums
controls.rationale: Low-contrast text is hard to read.
controls.remediation: Use design tokens that meet 4.5:1 for body text.
